In Round 7 of the group stage at the Total Chess World Championship Tour, Praggnanandhaa was playing against Richard Rapport.
Pragg was completely winning, but out of nowhere, he blundered a checkmate in one!
An absolutely shocking moment! Check out the game and the incredible reactions from Sagar, Harshit, David Howell and others. INSANE!
